description: Get the full conversation for one reservation, paginated. Each message has a subject, plain-text and HTML body, and type (1 = inbox / from guest, 2 = outbox / sent). Smoobu: GET /api/reservations/{reservationId}/messages.

only_related_to_guest.description: true = only guest-facing messages; false = every message on the booking.

name: smoobu_list_reservation_messages
title: List a reservation's messages
